phrase: an Affordable Prosthetics and Orthotics Business
verdict: Yes. fupro from Chandigarh pitched affordable prosthetics and orthotics on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. Many people who need limbs or braces can't afford them.
angle: Affordable prosthetics and orthotics serve accident victims, diabetics and people with disabilities. Clinics and government schemes help reach patients.
